description: Get £220 free — the biggest switch cash around right now. Plus a 5% regular saver.
rules: Open a new HSBC Bank Account on their app (no joint accounts).
Move your old card over within 60 days with 2 regular monthly payments connected.
Pay in £2,000 and spend £500 on the card within 60 days.
exclusions: You cannot claim if you are already an HSBC UK or first direct customer.
You cannot claim if you have opened an HSBC UK or first direct current account on or after 1 January 2023.
You cannot claim if you open a Basic Bank Account or a Premier Bank Account instead.
You must live in the UK and be 18 or over.
You must not be an HSBC staff member.
extraRequirements: You must open the account in the HSBC UK mobile banking app. Branch and phone applications do not qualify.
Pay at least £200 into a Santander Regular Saver held in your name within 60 days.
Keep both the Regular Saver and the Everyday account open, with 2 active Household Direct Debits, on the day Santander pays the £240.
description: Get £240 free on a fee-free account, plus 8% interest on a linked regular saver.
rules: Open a Santander Everyday current account and start a full switch using the Current Account Switch Service.
Within 60 days: complete the switch, pay in £1,500, and have 2 active household Direct Debits.
Also pay at least £200 into a Santander Regular Saver held in your name within 60 days.
By 7 October 2026: start the switch from an account that is not Santander, cahoot or Cater Allen.
Keep both the Regular Saver and the Everyday account open, with 2 active Household Direct Debits, on the day Santander pays the £240.
exclusions: You can't claim if you, or anyone on the account, held a Santander current account on 1 January 2026.
You can't claim if anyone named on the account has already had a Santander switch bonus.
The Direct Debits must be household bills such as council tax, energy, water, broadband, mobile, home phone or paid-for TV.
You must still hold the account and the 2 Direct Debits on the day Santander pays the bonus.
You must live in the UK.

description: Get £175 free, top customer service and a 0% overdraft.
rules: Open a 1st Account on or after 9 September, while the offer is available.
Within 45 days: switch using the Current Account Switch Service with at least 2 Direct Debits or standing orders.
Within 45 days: pay in £1,000. This can be one payment or several.
Within 45 days: make at least 5 debit card payments and log in to online banking or the app.
exclusions: You cannot claim if you are already a first direct customer or have held any first direct product.
You cannot claim if you have opened an HSBC current account on or after 1 January 2018.
Gambling transactions, credit card or insurance payments, cash withdrawals and card to card payments do not count towards the 5 card payments.
You must live in the UK and be 18 or over.

description: Get £175 free, plus 5% interest on up to £1,500 for a year and 1% cashback for 12 months.
rules: Open a FlexDirect account.
Move your old card over with 2 regular monthly payments within 28 days.
Within 31 days: pay in £1,000 and make at least one card payment.
exclusions: You cannot claim if you have had a Nationwide switch offer before, for a sole or joint account, since 2021.
You cannot claim if you are switching from a Nationwide or Virgin Money account.
You cannot claim if you requested your switch before 21 May 2026.
You must be switching a full account, not part of one.
extraRequirements: Your switch must complete within 28 days of opening your Nationwide account.
Gambling and crypto transactions, cash withdrawals and money transfers do not count towards the card payment.

description: Get £200 free, plus regular cashback and a 5.25% savings rate.
rules: Open a NatWest Select or Reward account.
Request a full switch using the Current Account Switch Service, closing your old account.
Within 60 days of the switch completing: pay in £1,250 and log in to the NatWest mobile app.
The £1,250 must stay in the account for at least 24 hours to count.
exclusions: You must live in the UK and be 18 or over.
You cannot claim if you held a NatWest current account on 6 May 2026.
You cannot claim if anyone on the account has had a NatWest, RBS or Ulster Bank switch offer before.
Your account must not be a Student, Graduate, Foundation, Reward Black, Premier Select or Premier Reward account.
extraRequirements: The £1,250 must stay in the account for at least 24 hours to count.

description: Get £200 free when you switch to an RBS Select or Reward account. No Direct Debits needed.
rules: Be a UK resident.
Open an RBS Select or Reward account.
Request a full switch using the Current Account Switch Service, closing your old account.
Within 60 days of the switch completing: pay in £1,250 and log in to the RBS mobile app.
The £1,250 must stay in the account for at least 24 hours to count.
exclusions: You cannot claim if you held an RBS current account on 6 May 2026.
You cannot claim if anyone on the account has had an RBS, NatWest or Ulster Bank switch offer before.
Your account must not be a Student, Graduate, Foundation, Reward Black, Premier Select or Premier Reward account.
You cannot switch from an RBS, NatWest or Ulster Bank account.
extraRequirements: The £1,250 must stay in the account for at least 24 hours to count.
